propositions: Closing a ticket invokes _compact_on_close which holds the store write lock for minutes (measured 13m53s), blocking all concurrent agent writes
Compaction on close is optional housekeeping not required for correctness; event logs remain valid unfolded and are replayed by the reducer
Removing _compact_on_close from the close path restores lock holds to seconds without affecting correctness or stored state
Compaction is retained as an explicit rebar compact <id> command and will become a scheduled out-of-band trigger in follow-up work
